children: Plains All American Pipeline and Plains GP Holdings have agreed to buy Silver Creek Midstream's Powder River Basin crude oil midstream assets for about $585 million in cash.

Plains on Wednesday said the acquired assets include about 600 miles of crude oil gathering and transmission pipelines, more than 350,000 barrels a day of operating capacity, roughly 1.2 million barrels of operational storage capacity and a 49% non-operated interest in the Powder River Gateway joint venture.

Houston-based energy infrastructure and logistics company Plains said Silver Creek's crude-oil gathering systems in the Powder River Basin provide customers with access to Plains' existing Rockies infrastructure through the Guernsey and Fort Laramie hubs.
Private-equity firms Tailwater Capital and Energy & Minerals Group own Silver Creek alongside the company's management.
